notes.32v.29b: Thorir's byname Hund means 'dog', so 'the dogs' (hundana) plays on it. The Finns (finnar) are the Sami.

nodes.text: tidings came to pass here, that King Olaf lost his life in this
the Stout struck with a sword at
Thorir Hund during the day. But where it landed it bit
one beat with a switch. And Thorir and they, twelve together, were in wolfskin coats
which the Finns had made for them with great sorcery.
saw that the sword did not bite, he called to the king
and said: The weapons do not bite the dogs.
said the king. Then Bjorn took a great club
